== Summary ==
Identified: none. A long-hair player touching the head of a bald player in a puffin shirt. The bald player is not [[Kevin Jaap]] (Kevin wears glasses in [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 17.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 22.jpg]]). The long-hair player is the same man as the plaid-shirt teammate in [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 22.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 European Championship]] weekend in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-13
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
